FM14.reasoning: The models are trained and evaluated on a single random train/validation split without cross-validation or multiple seed averaging.

FM15.reasoning: The agent evaluates the models solely on RMSE without verifying its robustness or checking secondary metrics.

other_failure_modes.name: train_test_feature_mismatch
other_failure_modes.description: Features are generated conditionally only during training (e.g., group-by aggregations) and missing features in the test set are simply filled with zeros, destroying the feature's meaning during inference.

other_failure_modes.name: unfitted_categorical_encoding
other_failure_modes.description: Categorical variables are encoded using independent label encoding (e.g. `.cat.codes`) on train and test sets separately, meaning the same category might receive different integer codes across splits.

summary: The agent implements a two-stage residual ensemble model with LGBM and an MLP. However, there are critical flaws in the feature engineering pipeline: group-by features are only computed on the training set and imputed as zeros in validation/test, and categorical encoding uses independent `.cat.codes` mapping across splits, which scrambles categorical variables between train and test.
